dct_description_sm: This project was aimed at monitoring and recording ground temperatures around the pile foundations of the School of Inuvik for analysis of the relationships between temperature, surface climate conditions, and subsurface changes in the soil in Inuvik. The analysis of the data collected will be used by the Government of Northwest Territories Public Works Services in the 'Good Building Practice for Northern Facilities, 3rd Edition' and to provide an adaptive strategy to reduce foundation systems' vulnerability to climate change.
dct_title_s: Permafrost Monitoring of the School of Inuvik
